Name: Smart Shipping - An Automate Companion
Author: TheGuyWithPies
Description:
[heading]Description[/heading]
Ever connected a shipping bin to your Automate setup only to have it sell items before they're finished processing?
Smart Shipping solves this problem by automatically detecting which items can be further processed by machines within an automation network.
For example, if your network contains kegs and casks, Smart Shipping will protect your fruit and normal quality wine from premature shipping, allowing your production chain to continue until the finished product is ready to sell.
Simply connect your shipping bin and let Smart Shipping handle the rest!
[heading]Installation Instructions[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI and Automate.[/*]
[*]Download Smart Shipping.[/*]
[*]Extract the SmartShipping folder into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Enjoy smarter automation![/*]
[/list]No additional configuration is necessary.
[heading]Main Features[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Intelligent Shipping:[/b] Automatically determines whether items can be further processed within their automation network.[/*]
[*][b]Ingredient and Fuel Protection:[/b] Prevents necessary production materials from being shipped prematurely, even when machines are busy.[/*]
[*][b]Dynamic Machine Detection:[/b] Automatically adapts when machines are added to or removed from your network.[/*]
[*][b]Global Blacklist:[/b] Manually select items that should never be automatically shipped.[/*]
[*][b]In-Game Blacklist Editor:[/b] Easily browse and search items using their names and in-game sprites.[/*]
[*][b]Modded Machine Support:[/b] Supports modded machines that use Stardew Valley's standard machine recipe system.[/*]
[*][b]Shipping Bin Support:[/b] Works with both regular and mini shipping bins.[/*]
[*][b]Manual Shipping Unaffected:[/b] You can still manually ship anything you normally could.[/*]
[/list][heading]Requirements[/heading]
[b]Required:[/b]
[list]
[*]SMAPI 4.0.0 or newer[/*]
[*]Automate 2.6.1 or newer[/*]
[/list][b]Optional:[/b]
[list]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu — (Technically optional but pretty much required for blacklisting) Provides convenient access to the blacklist editor and keyboard shortcut configuration.[/*]
[/list][heading]Compatibility and Known Limitations[/heading]
IMPORTANT NOTE: All my testing seemed to require advancing the in game day by one for the general mod to take effect. (Blacklisting works immediately once mod is fully implemented.)
Smart Shipping has been extensively tested with vanilla and modded production setups. However, machines that use custom-coded recipes may not be fully supported.
If you encounter a compatibility issue, please report it so I can investigate.
